review.notes: An isolated real tmux and Codex restore accepted a command, reported the bounded observation deadline, and then established a readable and writable App connection. The display should not collapse that accepted command into the failed-send count. This test checks the terminal report; actual pane startup has separate evidence.

cases.description: Restore summary keeps accepted but not observed startup pending
cases.setup: Five synthetic restore outcomes cover confirmed, pending, observation expired after a verified send, observation expired after an unknown send, and a refused send.
cases.action: Render the English and Chinese terminal summaries and each timeout row.
cases.expected: Only the verified-send timeout contributes to pending verification. Unknown transport and failed send stay in their respective outcome wording, and the timeout row preserves its observation limit.
